name: open_3d_model
description: Open and display a spinning 3D model on screen. Use whenever the user says 'show', 'open', 'display', 'load', or 'pull up' a 3D model. The only available model right now is 'Dum-E'. If the user asks for any robot arm, Dum-E, or any 3D model, call this with model_name='Dum-E'.

parameters.description: The filename stem of the model without extension. Currently only 'Dum-E' is available. Always use 'Dum-E' unless told otherwise.
Short display name shown on screen. Use just the model's name, e.g. 'Dum-E'. Do NOT include words like '3D', 'model', 'file', etc.
